data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'neos', meaning new, and 'ereteia', meaning virgin. Nerti is a spiritual name, representing the essence of newness and purity in a young girl. The name Nerti carries the meaning “Maiden, Young Girl” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Nerti usually hope their child will grow to embody maiden, young girl and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nerti total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
